c07_radix_bits.notes: digit bits per pass of every IDENTICAL device radix sort (sort_cols >= RADIX_MIN_ROWS and the C08 index sort); 8|6|4 bits = 4|6|8 passes; the sort has one answer

c07_radix_rows.notes: keys one (column, chunk) radix task counts and scatters; same words for every arm

c08_unique_scan.notes: PROMOTED 2026-10-08 (lane grid-act-3, grid ge123e6f9): incumbent -> scan ms NV/AMD istella, taxi: onehot 53.9->46.7 / 75.2->21.2, 41.7->32.1 / 72.1->18.2; ordinal 65.0->46.2 / 75.2->21.2, 49.0->30.2 / 71.5->17.5; target-encoder 188.3->175.4 / 142.3->88.4, 148.2->133.0 / 134.3->78.8; 0.525x combined; digests equal to the incumbent (no bits). Default on in IDENTICAL; arm off = MOJOLEARN_CLASSICAL_C08_UNIQUE_SCAN_OFF (old one-thread-per-column walk); the old on define is refused. device unique_cols op as a chunked run scan (count / per-column offsets / write) over all columns in 3 launches, replacing one thread per column walking n sorted rows; same words and counts as unique_cols_unit

c08_target_codes.notes: TargetEncoder fit builds categories + fit codes in one program; the device unique_inverse is rewritten as index radix sort + run boundaries + chunk offsets + inverse scatter (no binary search); the redundant sort_cols feeding it is skipped on device

c08_onehot_ft.notes: OneHotEncoder.fit_transform only; NOT reached by the board (it times fit then transform)

c08_ordinal_ft.notes: OrdinalEncoder.fit_transform only; NOT reached by the board (it times fit then transform)

c08_grouped_output.notes: 4 one-hot cells per task in op 9 (onehot emission); independent of the dictionary

expanded:target-encoder.route: fit: TargetEncoder._run -> (C08_TARGET_CODES) _fit_categories_with_codes: sort_cols[skipped on device] + unique_inverse[ddict] | (off) _fit_categories: sort_cols[radix] + unique_cols[C08_UNIQUE_SCAN] then _codes lookup; then fold target stats; transform: _codes + encode

expanded:onehot.route: fit: _fit_categories: sort_cols[radix] + unique_cols[C08_UNIQUE_SCAN]; transform: codes + onehot op 9[C08_GROUPED_OUTPUT]

expanded:ordinal.route: fit: _fit_categories: sort_cols[radix] + unique_cols[C08_UNIQUE_SCAN]; transform: codes lookup

expanded:kbins.route: fit (strategy=quantile): sort_cols[radix] (python/mojolearn/_expansion_prep.py:2214) + edges; transform: bin lookup

expanded:categorical-nb.route: fit: cat_hpart/cat_hfold or cat_counts on the given codes (no sort, no dictionary); predict: cat_jll
expanded:categorical-nb.notes: no C07/C08 control reaches CategoricalNB's public route; the review's C08 attribution for categorical-nb does not hold in code
